Alexander Wright
Data Scientist
Austin, TX | (512) 555-0144 | alexander.wright@email.com | linkedin.com/in/alexander-wright-ds
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Analytical and outcome-driven Data Scientist with over 4 years of proven industry experience mining massive
datasets and deploying high-performance predictive models. Expert in Python and SQL, with a deep understanding of
supervised/unsupervised machine learning algorithms, statistical analysis, and automated feature engineering
pipelines. Adept at turning complex exploratory data observations into clear, data-driven strategies for non-technical
stakeholders.
CORE COMPETENCIES
(cid:127) Python & R Programming (cid:127) SQL Database Querying (cid:127) Predictive ML Modeling
(cid:127) Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow (cid:127) Exploratory Data Analysis (cid:127) A/B Testing Frameworks
(cid:127) Tableau & Matplotlib (cid:127) Statistical Hypothesis Testing (cid:127) Cloud Infrastructure (AWS)
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Data Scientist – Nexus Analytics Corp 2024 – Present
(cid:127) Mined, cleaned, and engineered feature pipelines for massive structured and unstructured datasets across
multi-source enterprise APIs, ensuring 99.8% data integrity.
(cid:127) Designed and deployed a gradient-boosting classification model using Scikit-Learn that improved customer churn
forecasting accuracy by 14%, directly saving $220K in annual retention costs.
(cid:127) Formulated rigid A/B testing frameworks to validate new product feature algorithms, accurately measuring statistical
significance via hypothesis testing models.
(cid:127) Built interactive, automated executive dashboards in Tableau to communicate complex analytical narratives,
decreasing leadership metric evaluation overhead by 30%.
Junior Data Analyst – Vanguard Data Systems 2022 – 2024
(cid:127) Performed deep exploratory data analysis (EDA) using Pandas and Seaborn to identify operational anomalies and
uncover hidden demographic purchase patterns.
(cid:127) Optimized complex SQL script blocks and relational table joins, reducing daily query execution windows by 25%.
(cid:127) Collaborated directly with Data Engineers to build reliable ETL processing streams migrating on-premise
transactional histories to AWS cloud environments.
EDUCATION
Master of Science in Applied Statistics – State University (2022)
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science – Tech Institute (2020)
